array.string: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$HOME/.asdf/shims:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" log="$HOME/Library/Logs/update.log" printf '\n=== %s\n' "$(date)" >> "$log" "$HOME/dotfiles/bin/update" </dev/null >> "$log" 2>&1 || osascript -e "display notification \"$(tail -1 "$log")\" with title \"Daily update failed\" subtitle \"See ~/Library/Logs/update.log\""
